title: The Figma agent is generally available
description: Figma's agent exited beta with improved latency, cross-platform file search, configurable design-library guidelines, live teammate-agent visibility and custom skills.

title: Connect multiple GitHub organizations to Figma
description: Organization and Enterprise plans can connect multiple GitHub organizations to a single Figma plan, supporting code workflows across teams and projects.

title: Motion adds reusable styles, audio and Lottie export
description: Figma Motion added reusable custom animation styles, audio on timelines, character-level text animation and Lottie/dotLottie export.

title: Post riffs to Figma Community
description: Community riffs let users share ideas, animations, prototypes and experiments with the Figma Community and their profiles.

title: Smoother design collaboration and navigation on mobile
description: Figma's mobile app improved page switching, frame previews, exact-page sharing, individual frame exports and resume-where-you-left-off navigation.

title: Vertical wrap arrives in Auto Layout
description: Vertical Auto Layout can wrap overflow content into new columns, bringing responsive multi-column behavior closer to CSS flexbox.

title: AI Vision London focuses on human distinctiveness
description: Canva's AI Vision London programming emphasized workflow-first AI adoption, human judgment and distinctiveness as AI accelerates content production.

title: Create on-brand content with Figma designs in Weave
description: Figma Weave can connect Figma frames into workflows, preserve selected design attributes, create asset variations and sync connected assets with source designs.

title: Craft, upgraded: Canva ProSuite
description: Canva connected Affinity, Cavalry, Flourish and Leonardo into a broader professional creative suite, expanding its professional craft proposition.

title: Notion 3.7: Agent skills for your whole team
description: Notion introduced reusable AI skills, a shared skills library, automatic skill execution and executive-ready skill workflows.

title: Canva World Tour adds AI Essentials certification
description: Canva expanded free mobile-first learning and introduced an AI Essentials certification as part of its broader AI adoption push.

title: Control which AI models your agents can use
description: Business and Enterprise workspace owners can control which AI models are available to Notion Agent and Custom Agents and choose defaults.

title: 100 upgrades across the Visual Suite
description: Canva highlighted more than 100 upgrades across Docs, Sheets, Whiteboards, Presentations, Websites and other formats, reinforcing its connected productivity-and-creativity suite.

title: Agents can suggest edits
description: Notion Agents can propose changes for review instead of applying them directly, supporting controlled line-level editing workflows.

title: One million nonprofits now have Canva Pro for free
description: Canva announced that one million nonprofits could access Canva Pro for free, extending its ecosystem and adoption strategy among mission-driven organizations.

title: Developer Portal moves into the sidebar
description: Notion added a Developer section for Workers, connections, personal access tokens and execution logs, making the developer surface more accessible.

title: AI Meeting Notes can trigger Custom Agents
description: Custom Agents can run automatically after AI Meeting Notes finish, turning meeting summaries into status updates, action items or tickets.

title: New calendar tools for your agent
description: Notion Agents gained calendar tools for viewing schedules, moving meetings, sending invites and finding suitable meeting times.

title: External agents and Microsoft file support
description: Notion expanded its agent platform with external agents, support for reading and creating Microsoft file types, and additional MCP connections.
